vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species aedes_aegypti_lvpagwg --assembly AaegL5 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite [--tab|--vcf|--json]
fasta: the 25 contigs the records and the pruned cache's transcripts sit on (MT and 24 unplaced scaffolds) at their full length from Aedes_aegypti_lvpagwg.AaegL5.dna.chromosome.MT.fa and Aedes_aegypti_lvpagwg.AaegL5.dna.nonchromosomal.fa of Ensembl Metazoa release 63, every base outside the regions a run reads (each cached transcript's span with 5,000 bases of flank and each record with 2,000) masked to N; reference.fa.gz beside this file, compressed with bgzip, with reference.fa.gz.fai and reference.fa.gz.gzi for the compressed file and reference.fa.fai for its decompressed form; Ensembl VEP received the decompressed file as --fasta on every run
input: variants.vcf: 388 records, 61 on the mitochondrion MT and 327 on 24 unplaced scaffolds; the three chromosomes, 310 to 474 million bases each, are left out so that the reference stays small. 316 are designed records written by tools/vep-seeded-variants (generator version 2, seed 1, --records wide over MT and the 24 scaffolds that hold the most coding transcripts, 317 coding transcripts in all), their IDs naming the situation and an ordinal: twelve a situation, fewer where the sequences give fewer places. Among them, on the mitochondrion under genetic code table 5, a codon the table reads differently from the standard code, a start codon changed, a stop codon made and a stop codon lost, eight records each, and the deletion written across its origin; the first and the last base of twelve sequences; and twelve records whose sequence is written by a synonym of the cache's chr_synonyms.txt. Every designed record is kept by name. 72 are single-base substitutions from the variation files the Ensembl Metazoa release 63 cache carries for those sequences, their IDs the cache's: of 300 sampled with seed 1, sixty evenly spaced are kept by name and the others stand for the consequence-set combinations the sample shows, two exemplars per combination, stratified by variant class and strand, and six per combination carrying a protein-level term. The manifest's included_records name every record kept by name. MT translates under genetic code table 5 and every scaffold under table 1, each transcript's codon_table in the cache

hgvs-sift.vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 63 --species aedes_aegypti_lvpagwg --assembly AaegL5 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --fasta reference.fa --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --hgvs --sift b [--tab|--vcf|--json]

generator: tools/vep-seeded-variants --cache <converted cache> --seed 1 --records wide --fasta <genome> --sequence <each of the 25 sequences> for the designed records, and up to 300 single-base substitutions sampled with seed 1 from the cache's variation files of those sequences for the known variants; Ensembl VEP over the two inputs under default flags; tools/vep-golden-corpus select --release 63 --assembly AaegL5 --species aedes_aegypti_lvpagwg --dataset wide=<reference>=<the designed records> --dataset known=<reference>=<the sampled known variants> --k 2 --seed 1 --max-span 1000000 --max-records 500 --cache <converted cache> --flank 5000 --focus-term <frameshift_variant, inframe_deletion, inframe_insertion, protein_altering_variant, start_lost, start_retained_variant, stop_lost, stop_retained_variant, stop_gained, missense_variant, synonymous_variant, incomplete_terminal_codon_variant> --focus-k 6 --include <every designed record and sixty of the sampled known variants> --covers species-aedes-aaegl5 --covers genetic-code-tables --fasta-name reference.fa.gz; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except <the transcripts on which a record changes one residue, the rows SIFT scores> --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 63 --variations <cache>/variations over the whole cache tools/vep-storable-to-json converts from the Ensembl Metazoa release 63 AaegL5 cache (protein features kept for the DOMAINS column of the everything set; the variation slices hold the known variants within one base of a record); scripts/fixtures/cut_plugin_regions.py --reference <genome> --flank 5000 --record-flank 2000 over the corpus with each record's sequence written by the cache's name; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus --no-stats for the manifest's run and each flag set; tools/vep-golden-corpus flag-set (everything, hgvs-sift) and classify (the manifest's run and both flag sets, --field HGVSc --field HGVSp --field HGVS_OFFSET for the everything set and the same with --field SIFT for the hgvs-sift set)

pruned_cache.variation_slices: the known variants within one base of a record under variations/<chr>/all_vars.gz with its .csi, as the Ensembl VEP cache lays them out; a sequence with no known variant beside a record carries the empty indexed file
